title: ToolRequest
description: Governed tool-execution request produced by the CNL bridge (src/cnl_bridge.rs action_to_tool_request) and admitted by the executor (src/executor/mod.rs). Canonical: cnl_bridge::canonical_action_string uses serde_json with sorted keys, matching chain.ts canonicalJson.

tool.description: Tool name: deploy | scale | destroy | revoke.

args.description: Positional arguments in canonical order (service, target, replicas for deploy; service, replicas for scale; service for destroy; previous_action_id for revoke).

idempotency_key.description: Client-supplied dedup key. The executor derives effective_idempotency_key = SHA-256(principal|tool|args|dry_run|client key).

dry_run.description: When true the executor plans a receipt (status "plan") without invoking any side effect.

principal.description: Caller identity used in the effective idempotency key.
